name: Veloshift Site Migration
author: lacortedev

sections.description:
Veloshift Site Migration is an enterprise-grade WordPress migration and cloning plugin engineered to move your database, media library, plugins, themes, and site configurations seamlessly without server timeouts, memory exhaustion, or corrupted serialized data.

Key Features

  • Timeout & Memory Exhaustion Immunity: Micro-chunk time slicing processes operations in 3.5-second windows, safely checkpointing state before server execution limits are reached.
  • Dual-Engine Execution: Reactive browser heartbeat runner with automated loopback fallback for unattended background execution.
  • Granular Selective Migration: Choose exactly what to export (database tables, post revisions, comments, users, media, plugins, themes).
  • Cloud Relay Site-to-Site Sync: Stream data securely between sites routed through our Cloud Relay service, eliminating firewall and NAT port restrictions without direct incoming exposure.
  • Recursive Serialized Search & Replace: Accurately rewrites site URLs and filesystem paths across serialized objects and JSON without string length corruption.
  • Chunked Dropzone Uploader: Upload packages of any size without being blocked by host upload_max_filesize limits.
  • Administrator-Supervised Restoration: Full site restoration is always explicitly initiated and authorized by a logged-in site administrator from the WordPress dashboard.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Veloshift Cloud Relay Service to facilitate site-to-site transfers between servers where direct incoming connections are blocked by firewalls, NAT, or strict SSL proxy configurations. All site-to-site migrations are securely routed through this external service.

  • Service Provider: Veloshift Cloud Relay (https://8hz78s.lacorte.dev)
  • Purpose: Relays migration data chunks over HTTPS between source and destination WordPress sites and checks cloud relay bandwidth availability and membership status.
  • Data Transmitted: WordPress site URL, temporary migration session token, instance identifier, relay membership license key when configured, and chunked migration packages. Packages can contain the selected database contents and site files, including personal data.
  • When Data Is Sent: When an administrator tests a connection or starts a Cloud Relay transfer, and when a saved relay membership key is verified from the plugin administration screens. Local package export and restore do not require a relay membership key.
  • Terms of Service: https://members.lacorte.dev/veloshift-site-migration/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://members.lacorte.dev/veloshift-site-migration/privacy
  • Cloud Relay Quota: The Cloud Relay Service provides a free tier of up to 10 GB per migration. Migrations exceeding 10 GB routed through the external cloud relay service require an active relay membership license. Local file package export and restore (.wpmig) remain completely free and unlimited on your server.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the veloshift-site-migration folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the ZIP file via Plugins ➜ Add New ➜ Upload Plugin in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Access Veloshift from the left-hand navigation menu.
sections.faq:
Why is there a 10 GB quota on Cloud Relay transfers?

The 10 GB quota applies exclusively to transfers routed through our high-speed Veloshift Cloud Relay service, which incurs significant cloud bandwidth and computing infrastructure costs. Local .wpmig archive export and restore on your own server is completely free with no size restrictions.

Does Veloshift Site Migration support WooCommerce and custom post types?

Yes. Veloshift Site Migration scans all database tables (both standard WordPress tables and third-party custom tables created by WooCommerce, ACF, Elementor, and others).

Will my serialized data break during URL replacement?

No. Veloshift Site Migration features an in-depth recursive serialized and JSON search & replace engine that recalculates PHP serialization byte lengths (s:len:"..."), preventing corrupted widgets, menus, or page builder layouts.

Can a remote site automatically overwrite my website?

No. For security and guideline compliance, remote inbound transfers only store the package archive in your isolated storage folder. The actual restoration process must be explicitly confirmed and initiated by a logged-in site administrator via the WordPress dashboard.
sections.changelog:
1.0.6

  • Verify TLS certificates on migration requests.
  • Renamed plugin to Veloshift Site Migration with slug veloshift-site-migration in full compliance with trademark and uniqueness guidelines.
  • Updated contributor listing to lacortedev in readme.txt.
  • Implemented atomic Compare-And-Swap execution lock in Job Manager to prevent race conditions during concurrent requests.
  • Ensured all site-to-site transfers strictly require and route through the Cloud Relay service.
  • Removed local license checks and quotas from plugin code, ensuring local functionality is fully compliant with Guideline 5.
  • Ensured package restoration is explicitly authorized and initiated by a logged-in site administrator, removing any remote administrative execution.

1.0.5

  • Enhanced compliance with WordPress.org detailed plugin guidelines.
  • Documented third-party cloud relay service, terms of service, and privacy disclosures.
  • Refined admin interface and cloud relay bandwidth quota notices.
  • Optimized database stream unbuffered chunking.
  • Improved OPcache invalidation handling on managed hosts.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
